I replied to Marcus in his #north-team thread: the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on 25 November.

That date comes from Ilse's message in #north-team on 14 October, and nobody has corrected it since. Marcus is a member of #north-team, so he can see that message himself. I didn't look at any other channels or private messages.

There's nothing to check the date against. The share has no files for Brackenwater, and the North team summary files mention the account but give no renewal date. I told Marcus that Ilse's message is the only source I have.
